{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Dust Dancer'' has entered the system. Wynn will be here within half an hour by shuttle.|[[Desha Lor]], to [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
The '''''Dust Dancer''''' was a [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] cargo [[Transport/Legends|transport]] arranged by former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Booster Terrik]] to be loaned to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The Jedi Order used it in [[44 ABY]] to transport well-known individuals off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] in the [[Pyria system]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. [[Shuttle/Legends|Shuttles]] attached to the ''Dust Dancer'' were then used to take the individuals to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on Coruscant.

==Description==
The [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]-manufactured ''Dust Dancer'' was an eighty-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long cargo [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. It was capable of holding two [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], one of which was the ''[[DeepRay]]''. The ''Dust Dancer'' had a ball for its [[Cockpit/Legends|command center]] at one end and many [[Engine/Legends|engines]] at the other. A long connecting spar joined the bow and the stern together; this spar was thickly covered with cargo pods and shuttle attachment points.<ref name="Conviction" />

==History==
{{Quote|If you'll give us landing authorization, we'll bring the ''Dancer'' down and off-load.|Seha Dorvald, to Dolo Karenzi|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
A legitimate cargo transport, the ''Dust Dancer'' was arranged by former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Booster Terrik]] to be loaned to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Conviction" /> In [[44 ABY]], Terrik invited some very well-known individuals to his personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'', for a large [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] [[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge|tournament]]. In actuality, he had brought the sabacc players onto his ship as hostages to prevent the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] from moving to control the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which planned to deploy its forces off the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] against the wishes of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]. Terrik used the hostages to force Daala to let the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leave.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref> After the Jedi completed their mission, he loaned the ''Dust Dancer'' to the Jedi so they could use it to transport the celebrities back to Coruscant.<ref name="Conviction" />

[[File:Errant_Venture.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Errant Venture'']]
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Octa Ramis]], along with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Seha Dorvald]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the ''Dust Dancer'' to the planet [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] in the [[Pyria system]] just before Terrik left his hostages there. The Jedi brought the ''Dust Dancer'' into [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above Borleias, and Dorvald took a shuttle down to the planet's surface. On Borleias, she met with [[Dolo Karenzi]], the night-shift [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] of the [[Borleias outpost]], and told him that the ''Dust Dancer'' was carrying a load of consumable luxury items&mdash;expensive [[Wine/Legends|wines]], exotic foods, fresh sabacc decks, entertainment [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]], candies, and pastries&mdash;with the outpost as the items' listed destination. Karenzi realized that there had to have been a mistake, but he decided to sign for the items in the ''Dust Dancer'' and keep them himself, hidden in a storage pod. After the ''Dust Dancer'' landed, Karenzi attempted to unload the cargo fast. Right in the middle of the off-loading process, however, the ''Errant Venture'' entered the [[Star system/Legends|system]] to drop off the celebrities. Karenzi quickly hid the cargo and made a false manifest for the ''Dust Dancer'' so no one would know about the real cargo.<ref name="Conviction" />

The Jedi had planned for the ''Dust Dancer'' to be the only transport available to send the celebrities back to Coruscant once the ''Errant Venture'' left the sabacc players on Borleias, and Ramis and Dorvald piloted the celebrities to the capital aboard the ''Dust Dancer''. Once on Coruscant, the players were ferried by the ''Dust Dancer''{{'s}} shuttles into the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. Unbeknownst to the players, however, several Jedi had hidden in the shuttles' smuggling compartments, providing them easy access to the building so they could prepare for a [[Plan Delta|coup]] against Chief of State Daala.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Commanders and crew==
Former smuggler Booster Terrik received the transport ''Dust Dancer'' from a contact and then loaned the ship to the Jedi Order to pick up the celebrities whom Terrik had held hostage after dropping them off on Borleias. Jedi Octa Ramis and Seha Dorvald piloted the ''Dust Dancer'' when they picked up the celebrities and took them to Coruscant.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Dust Dancer'' made its first appearance in the seventh novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]] and published in [[2011]].<ref name="Conviction" />
